usage: A 鍵盤 is used to input text and commands into a computer or device.
When talking about computer parts, 鍵盤 always refers to the keyboard component.
You can describe the condition or type of a 鍵盤, like a wireless or mechanical keyboard.
In everyday conversation, people often say '打鍵盤' which means typing on the keyboard.
The word 鍵盤 can be combined with other words, such as 鍵盤手 (keyboard player) in music.
